Looked like I was groveling at his feet. Very disgraceful. Let it look disgraceful; who was asking about appearances now?

The more I struggled, the more the pain came back. It had been settling, and now it was up again. That could also go to hell.

I raised myself.
...Legs wouldn't hold.

Fine. Upper body, then. I forced strength into my stiff arms and made them support me.

There was Suzukawa. Still standing with both hands raised, gazing up at the ceiling, fully drunk on himself—or that was how it looked from here.

Were you actually an idiot, by any chance?

I struck the floor with both hands. The recoil lifted me, just a little.

Enough to fold my legs under me. From my knees onto the soles of my feet.

The injury in my foot worsened under my weight. Again that wild electric rush of pain.

Swallow it. Bite it down. Send it inside.

I straightened my knees. More weight. More pain. Ignore.

I stood.
In front of Suzukawa.
Facing my enemy.

Elbow folded. Arm tight against my side. Draw it back.

Even now he apparently couldn't work out what I was starting. Only that suspicious look came down at me.

Left foot forward. My knee shook with pain. Hold.

I clenched my fist, turned my hips as far as they would go—

and hit him.

The last bomb. The one that struck home.

Cracks ran all over the warrior.
Or—that was how it looked.

The iron body wavered. Shook. Showing the turmoil inside that armor. And anger.

Fury. Blind rage.

After that, protect Konatsu and Tadayasu, get out of here...
Feeling faint didn't begin to cover it.
